title: Password Generator
description: Create strong passwords with configurable length, letters, numbers, and symbols.
metaDescription: Generate strong passwords online with letters, numbers, symbols, and custom length.

form.title: Generate password
form.description: Configure length and character types to create a strong password.

seo.about: The generator creates random passwords in the browser, with options for length and character types. The password is not saved to favorites or sent to the server.
seo.howToUse: Choose the length, select the desired sets, and generate a new password. The shared link preserves only settings, not the generated password.
